correction.reason: The stored O4 probability cache honestly falls back to O0 on 203 rows without a retained teacher view. That fallback is valid for D1 but cannot be described as a per-primitive teacher score in D4.
correction.D1: Unchanged: use the exact sealed O4 cache including its declared O0 fallback because D1 reproduces the existing O4 current-support oracle.
correction.D4: Use O4 final canonical-negative probability only on rows whose teacher_view_mask has at least one retained view. Rows without a teacher view are explicitly unavailable and abstain at score zero; no O0 value is imputed as teacher evidence.
correction.D4_reporting: Report both available-row primitive metrics and end-to-end primitive metrics over all target-observed rows, with unavailable teacher rows fixed to abstention.
correction.D5: Render the exact end-to-end D4 membership, including explicit abstention on teacher-unavailable rows.
